KP 1. Integrating Sine and Cosine
1.?

∫4cos⁡ydy=

E
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:16 PM|Elapsed: 0:19Correct

Recall that

∫cos⁡ydy=sin⁡y+C.

Therefore, we have

∫4cos⁡ydy=4∫cos⁡ydy=4(sin⁡y)+C=4sin⁡y+C.

2.?

∫(sin⁡x+5cos⁡x)dx=

M
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:17 PM|Elapsed: 0:16Correct

Recall that

∫sin⁡xdx=−cos⁡x+C,∫cos⁡xdx=sin⁡x+C.

Therefore, we have

∫(sin⁡x+5cos⁡x)dx=∫sin⁡xdx+5∫cos⁡xdx=−cos⁡x+5sin⁡x+C.

KP 2. Integrating Secant-Tangent and Cosecant-Cotangent
3.?

∫(3cos⁡x−2sec⁡xtan⁡x)dx=

M
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:17 PM|Elapsed: 0:21Correct

Recall that

∫cos⁡xdx=sin⁡x+C,∫sec⁡xtan⁡xdx=sec⁡x+C.

Therefore, we have

∫(3cos⁡x−2sec⁡xtan⁡x)dx=3∫cos⁡xdx−2∫sec⁡xtan⁡xdx=3sin⁡x−2sec⁡x+C.

4.?

∫(−8csc⁡ycot⁡y)dy=

E
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:18 PM|Elapsed: 1:11Correct

Recall that

∫csc⁡ycot⁡ydy=−csc⁡y+C.

Therefore, we have

∫(−8csc⁡ycot⁡y)dy=−8∫csc⁡ycot⁡ydy=−8(−csc⁡y)+C=8csc⁡y+C.

KP 3. Integrating Secant Squared
5.?

∫(2sec2⁡x−sin⁡x)dx=

M
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:19 PM|Elapsed: 0:18Incorrect

Recall that

∫sin⁡xdx=−cos⁡x+C,∫sec2⁡xdx=tan⁡x+C.

Therefore, we have

∫(2sec2⁡x−sin⁡x)dx=∫2sec2⁡xdx−∫sin⁡xdx=2tan⁡x−(−cos⁡x)+C=2tan⁡x+cos⁡x+C.

Your Answer:
2tan⁡x−cos⁡x+C
6.?

∫−32sec2⁡xdx=

E
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:20 PM|Elapsed: 0:13Correct

Recall that

∫sec2⁡xdx=tan⁡x+C

Therefore, we get

∫−32sec2⁡xdx=−32∫sec2⁡xdx=−32(tan⁡x)+C=−32tan⁡x+C.

7.?

∫(sec⁡xtan⁡x−sec2⁡x)dx=

M
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:21 PM|Elapsed: 0:45Correct

Recall that

∫sec⁡xtan⁡xdx=sec⁡x+C,∫sec2⁡xdx=tan⁡x+C.

Therefore, we have

∫(sec⁡xtan⁡x−sec2⁡x)dx=∫sec⁡xtan⁡xdx−∫sec2⁡xdx=sec⁡x−tan⁡x+C.

KP 4. Integrating Cosecant Squared
8.?

∫3csc2⁡x−4sec⁡xtan⁡xdx=

M
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:22 PM|Elapsed: 0:34Incorrect

Recall that

∫sec⁡xtan⁡xdx=sec⁡x+C,∫csc2⁡xdx=−cot⁡x+C.

Therefore, we get

∫3csc2⁡x−4sec⁡xtan⁡xdx=3∫csc2⁡xdx−4∫sec⁡xtan⁡xdx=3(−cot⁡x)−4(sec⁡x)+C=−3cot⁡x−4sec⁡x+C.

Your Answer:
−3cot⁡x+4csc2⁡x+C
9.?

∫−52csc2⁡xdx=

E
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:22 PM|Elapsed: 0:27Correct

Recall that

∫csc2⁡xdx=−cot⁡x+C

Therefore, we get

∫−52csc2⁡xdx=−52∫csc2⁡xdx=−52(−cot⁡x)+C=52cot⁡x+C.

10.?

∫(sec⁡xtan⁡x−2csc2⁡x+sin⁡x)dx=

H
Sun, Sep 13th @ 3:23 PM|Elapsed: 0:49Correct

Recall that

∫csc2⁡xdx=−cot⁡x+C,∫sec⁡xtan⁡xdx=sec⁡x+C,∫sindx=−cos⁡x+C.

Therefore, we get

∫(sec⁡xtan⁡x−2csc2⁡x+sin⁡x)dx=∫sec⁡xtan⁡xdx−2∫csc2⁡xdx+∫sin⁡xdx=sec⁡x−2(−cot⁡x)+(−cos⁡x)+C=sec⁡x+2cot⁡x−cos⁡x+C.
